notes:
• Text to Gesture is easier to use: each community result is one card for its post, with the word you searched highlighted. Tap it to open the post.
• Before you search, Text to Gesture shows your recent searches, words to try from the lessons and the newest community posts.
• Back now goes one step at a time: from a post back to your results, then to the start of Text to Gesture.
• Smoother screen animations in Text to Gesture.
